title: Do Americans live longer than people in China? True or false
description: Three statements about how long people live in the USA, Spain, China and Saudi Arabia. Real World Bank life expectancy data (2024). How many did you get right?
source: World Bank, life expectancy at birth (2024) and GDP per capita (2025), data.worldbank.org

segments.text: True or false? Spaniards live five years longer than Americans.

props.statement: People in Spain live 5 years longer than Americans

segments.text: True. And America is more than twice as rich.
Next. Americans live longer than the Chinese.

props.statement: Americans live longer than people in China

segments.text: True. But by less than one year.
Last one. Americans live longer than people in Saudi Arabia.

props.statement: Americans live longer than people in Saudi Arabia

segments.text: False. Saudi Arabia wins by about a month.
How many did you get? Follow for more.
